verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents exporting its rendered outputs in standard formats: finished videos can be downloaded as .mp4 via a time-limited API download link, and SCORM export is listed on the pricing page. Nothing shows a way to export all account data (projects, scripts, avatars, brand kits, interaction or quiz results) or any portability or offboarding path, so only the finished-video slice of the story is covered. Missing for 10: bulk/full-account data export, export of editable project sources and scripts, export of avatar/brand assets and analytics, documented open-format portability or exit process, independent corroboration.
